## Objective

Clearly describe the outcome this ticket should achieve.

## Background

Explain why the work is needed and provide relevant context.

## Implementation Tasks

- [ ] Add concrete implementation steps here.
- [ ] Each task should describe an observable action.
- [ ] Avoid vague items such as "set things up" or "improve configuration."

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Define behavior or results that must be true before this ticket is complete.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria should be objectively verifiable.

## Testing

Document the commands, tests, or manual verification required.

## Documentation

List documentation that must be created or updated.

Use `N/A` if no documentation change is required.

## Dependencies

List prerequisite tickets, external dependencies, or blockers.

Use `None` if there are no known dependencies.
